name: easybrowser
description: Simple, secure, AI-powered browser for elderly and non-technical people.
author: re-invertion

scripts.dev: sh -c 'unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE DISPLAY; export XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=wayland ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1; if [ -d /mnt/wslg/runtime-dir ]; then export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/mnt/wslg/runtime-dir; export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-wayland-0}; fi; exec electron-vite dev -- --enable-features=UseOzonePlatform --ozone-platform=wayland'
scripts.preview: sh -c 'unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE DISPLAY; export XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=wayland ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1; if [ -d /mnt/wslg/runtime-dir ]; then export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/mnt/wslg/runtime-dir; export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-wayland-0}; fi; exec electron-vite preview -- --enable-features=UseOzonePlatform --ozone-platform=wayland'
